sloka: आर्षो अयम् देवि निष्यन्दो यः त्वाम् अभिगमिष्यति ।एतौ पादौ मया स्निग्धौ शिरोभिः परिपीडितौ ॥३-५५-३५॥
transliteration: ārṣo ayam devi niṣyando yaḥ tvām abhigamiṣyati ।etau pādau mayā snigdhau śirobhiḥ paripīḍitau ॥3-55-35॥

translations.english: I am bowing down, pressing my heads at your shining feet. I am at your mercy. Grant me your favourI will remain your slave and remain ever under your control.
